subject: Coordinating split invoices for EMEA pilot — ledger slicing & VAT flow
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@fincoexample.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinCo Billing Ops <billing@fincoexample.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot: multi-entity invoice split for EMEA subscription

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, our EMEA rollout needs invoices that can be split across three legal entities for tax and local accounting. We attached an example of how FinCo expects lines to be grouped (FinCo-expected-invoice-structure.pdf).

High level asks:
- Can Redwood generate a single billing event for the customer, but produce invoice artifacts that allocate line items to multiple legal entities/cost centers?
- We need VAT routing per line (reverse charge vs standard VAT) and the ability to show entity VAT numbers on the invoice PDF for each slice.
- Preferably the system can accept an allocation CSV (we can provide a mapping) and output separate invoice PDFs that we can post to our ledgers.

Timing: pilot kickoff next week is ideal. Can you confirm what data you need from us (VAT numbers, GL codes, cost center ids) and any limitations on your side?

Thanks,
Olivia
Billing Ops // FinCo Analytics
attachments: FinCo-expected-invoice-structure.pdf (pdf)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@fincoexample.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot: multi-entity invoice split for EMEA subscription

Hi Olivia — appreciate the clear summary and the example doc.

Short answers up front: yes, we can support a workflow that takes a single charge and emits multiple invoice PDFs mapped to different legal entities/cost centers. There are a few ways to implement this depending on desired downstream behavior:

- Option A (preferred for bookkeeping): Redwood emits separate invoice PDFs labeled to each entity, with per-line VAT and VAT number, and we additionally emit a single aggregated accounting record for the charge so your AR reconciles to one customer payment.
- Option B (if your ERP requires separate posted invoices): Redwood emits separate accounting events per entity (this requires a billing policy change and is supported in Dedicated/Private deployments).

What we need from you to scope the pilot:
1) Allocation CSV: line_id -> entity_id -> cost_center -> % or fixed amount (example CSV looks good).
2) VAT registration numbers for EMEA entities + any reverse-charge indicators per country.
3) Preferred invoice template rules (where to display VAT numbers per slice).
4) Example GL mapping if you want automatic ledger tags.

I attached a quick invoice-slicing template (redwood-invoice-slicing-v1.xlsx) showing the fields our ingestion accepts. If you can return a filled CSV, Marissa and Neha will validate tax routing.

Proposed next steps:
- You send allocation CSV by Wednesday (11/04).
- Marissa will review tax/VAT rules and flag issues.
- Marcus will confirm any billing-system limitations and propose a fallback.

Happy to jump on a 30-minute call to walk through the template.

Best,
David
Head of Partnerships // Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-invoice-slicing-v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@fincoexample.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T13:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot: multi-entity invoice split for EMEA subscription

David / team — looping in high-level tax guidance for the pilot. See attached notes (vat-routing-guidance.md). Key points:

- For EMEA, we must place the VAT registration number for the entity that is 'supplying' the goods/services on the invoice slice. If the customer is VAT-registered and B2B, some lines may be reverse charge (no VAT shown).
- We will need: entity VAT number, country code, your customer's VAT number (if B2B), and whether the line is service vs software for local tax rules.
- PDF generation: we can render per-entity VAT block and include a small reconciliation summary page that ties all slices to the single payment reference.

Practical constraints:
- Our hosted template supports up to 10 invoice slices in the current renderer. If you need more, we'll need to batch into multiple PDFs or adjust the renderer.
- Tax calculation: if FinCo expects different tax calculations per line (e.g., mixed reverse-charge and standard VAT), we need the per-line tax flags in the CSV.

If Olivia can push the CSV, we'll validate quickly and flag any missing VAT ids.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Ops // Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pilot: multi-entity invoice split for EMEA subscription

Quick technical note and workaround idea — the billing ledger we use in hosted mode expects one canonical invoice record per charge. If we need separate posted invoices in your ERP, two approaches:

- Workaround 1 (fast): Redwood produces one billing event and multiple PDF artifacts (one per entity). You post the PDFs to each entity ledger manually or via ingestion. This keeps AR reconciliation simple (single payment id).
- Workaround 2 (phased): For Dedicated/Private customers we can enable per-entity posted invoices (each with its own invoice id). That will require a brief config change and extra compliance checks; timeline ~3 weeks.

Action items I suggest:
- For the pilot, use Workaround 1. We'll ensure the PDFs include a reconciliation block with the single payment reference, line allocation summary, and entity VAT numbers.
- Marissa to confirm VAT blocks are correct.
- David to confirm SOW sign-off and schedule the technical intake call.
